footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Dine Brands: after $1.1M of preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 28, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 8.2% to $879M in 2025 (ended Dec 28, 2025). Gross margin was 63.2%, versus 58.2% a year earlier, and operating income fell 35.6% to $104M, a 11.8% margin.
Net income fell 74.6% to $16.0M, or $1.11 per share. Operating cash flow was $89.0M and free cash flow $53.4M, versus $94.1M; Dine Brands returned $91.7M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Dine Brands Global, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
